## Summary

Background sensor noise and transient environmental minor/warning alarms generating an alarm storm with zero customer impact.

No customer impact; availability remained 100% with normal traffic metrics despite 30 transient minor and warning alarms.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-05 05:09: Minor FAN_FAILURE alarm raised on S-TUN-009. [ALM-000077]

- S-TUN-009 experienced 30 self-clearing minor and warning alarms between 05:09 and 06:05. [T3, ALM-000077, ALM-000080]

## Hypotheses

1. **no_impact** at S-TUN-009: confirmed. Exact signature of background noise and nuisance alarms with self-clearing minor/warning events and normal KPIs. [RB-NUISANCE-ALARMS#02, T3, T4]
2. **power_failure** at S-TUN-009: rejected. Site availability remained 100% and no critical power outage alarms were triggered. [T3, T4]

- ALM-000077: Minor FAN_FAILURE alarms were transient and self-clearing with no customer impact.

- Monitor S-TUN-009 for any recurring environmental sensor flapping.
- Inspect cabinet physical seals and cooling fans during the next routine maintenance visit.
